village.Name: Village
village.Comfortable: A room at a peasant's cottage
village.Raid: The peasants informed – the reeve leads the watch!

easy.Name: Easy target
easy.Desc: +20 to the test, half the loot

rich.Name: Rich target
rich.Desc: −20 to the test, double loot, any failure risks getting caught

recon.Name: Recon
recon.Desc: +20 to the next theft or robbery

commotion.Name: Commotion
commotion.Desc: +20 to the next tested job (today); the party may use it too

Tokens.UntilWeekEnd: until the end of the week

valuables: Signet ring with a family crest
weapons: Rapier with an ornate basket hilt

scout.Name: Scout the Area
scout.Desc: Reconnaissance before a job: patrols, hideouts, weak spots. Success grants a Recon token.

shadow.Name: Shadow a Target
shadow.Desc: Discreetly watch a specific person. Success grants a Recon token.

tavern.Name: Listen at the Tavern
tavern.Desc: A few rounds and a keen ear. An outstanding success grants a Lead to a rich target.

Descs.village: Talk at the well and in the inn. An outstanding success grants a Lead to a rich target.

procure.Name: Scavenge and Forage
procure.Desc: Search abandoned places and pick up whatever lies around. Supplies and small coin.

pickpocket.Name: Pickpocketing
pickpocket.Reward: coin (1d10+5 SS × target), sometimes a valuable
pickpocket.Desc: Light fingers in a crowd. Cash at once, and sometimes something to fence.

burglary.Name: Burglary
burglary.Desc: A night entry into a house, counting house or temple. The loot must be fenced later.
burglary.InputPlaceholder: e.g. a merchant's counting house, a councillor's townhouse

farm_theft.Name: Farmyard Theft
farm_theft.Desc: Chickens, sacks of grain, tools from the barn. Supplies at once and goods for the fair.

poaching.Name: Poaching
poaching.Desc: Snares and a bow in the lord's forest. Fresh meat for the crew.

Descs.mountains: Hunting on rocky ledges. Fresh meat for the crew.

highway_robbery.Name: Highway Robbery
highway_robbery.Desc: Stop the wagon, disarm the escort, take the goods. Risk of wounds on failure.

mine_raid.Name: Raid a Mine
mine_raid.Desc: A night raid on a shaft or ore store. Dwarf smugglers pay well for metal.

fence.Name: Fence the Loot
fence.Desc: Sell the loot. The price depends on the fence, a Haggle test and whether the goods are still hot.

intimidate.Name: Intimidation / Extortion
intimidate.Desc: A one-off shakedown of a stallholder or innkeeper.

racket.Name: Protection Racket
racket.Desc: Put a street under “protection”. Daily income, but rivals may come to claim it.

rumor_spread.Name: Spread Rumours
rumor_spread.Desc: Spread news that misleads enemies or drums up custom.
rumor_spread.InputPlaceholder: e.g. The watch is looking for someone in the south

bribe.Name: Bribery
bribe.Reward: release from gaol, Heat −1 or a favour
bribe.Desc: A bribe for a guard, clerk or toll officer: free a prisoner, hush things up or buy a favour.

theman.Name: The Man's Network
theman.Reward: a message to the syndicate (no test)
theman.Desc: A coded message to the local cell of the syndicate.

distract.Name: Diversion and Brawl
distract.Desc: Draw attention away before a job. Success grants a Commotion token for today.

sabotage.Name: Sabotage
sabotage.Desc: Destroy a bridge, wagon, warehouse or machine.
sabotage.InputPlaceholder: e.g. a bridge on the road, a supply wagon

smuggle.Name: Smuggling
smuggle.Desc: Get goods or people past a checkpoint. Good pay; getting caught means gaol.
smuggle.InputPlaceholder: e.g. a crate of weapons through the west gate

forge.Name: Forge Documents
forge.Desc: Travel passes, letters of safe conduct, bills of exchange and seals.
forge.InputPlaceholder: e.g. a travel pass bearing the Graf's seal

cover_tracks.Name: Cover Tracks
cover_tracks.Desc: Erase the trail and move camp. The only way to lower Heat yourselves.

tend_wounded.Name: Tend the Wounded
tend_wounded.Desc: Fresh dressings and herbs for a wounded comrade.

patrol.Name: Patrol
patrol.Reward: Recon token; on SL 3+ a Lead and a trophy
patrol.Desc: A squad sweeps the area, looking for the enemy and good roads.
patrol.Success: {name} leads the patrol and returns with the lie of the land.
patrol.Fail: {name} wanders the wilds and comes back with nothing.

garrison.Name: Garrison Duty
garrison.Desc: Quiet service at a gate, bridge or storehouse. Small but steady money.
garrison.Success: {name} stands the watch and collects the pay.
garrison.Fail: {name} falls asleep at the post. Nobody pays for a watch like that.

requisition.Name: Requisition
requisition.Desc: Supplies from the locals, with a receipt or without. Failure hurts the company's name.
requisition.Success: {name} returns with a cart of provisions.
requisition.Fail: {name} meets resistance from the peasants and returns empty-handed.

escort.Name: Escort
escort.Desc: Protecting a merchant, a cart or a messenger on a dangerous stretch.
escort.InputPlaceholder: e.g. a merchant from Nuln, a salt cart...
escort.Fail: {name} failed to protect: {target}. The men have lost heart.

contract.Name: Contract
contract.Reward: 3d10+10 SS times the contract tier (SL 3+: trophy)
contract.Desc: A paid military task: breaking a warband, defending a village, retaking a depot.
contract.InputPlaceholder: e.g. break the band on the highway...
contract.Fail: {name} fails the contract: {target}. The employer will not pay and will talk.

drill.Name: Drill
drill.Desc: A full day of formation practice. The men curse, then fight better.
drill.Success: {name} works the men hard. The line looks as it should.
drill.Fail: {name} shouts all day and the line still falls apart.

ambush.Name: Turn on the Hunters
ambush.Desc: The band waits in the undergrowth for those who hunt it. A good ambush scares off pursuit.
ambush.Success: {name} springs the ambush. The hunters flee and leave their weapons behind.
ambush.Fail: {name} walks into their own trap. The band falls back in disorder.

ransom.Name: Ransom
ransom.Desc: Seize a wealthy traveller and write to the family. The gold comes, but people talk.
ransom.InputLabel: Who are you holding for ransom?
ransom.InputPlaceholder: e.g. the miller's son, a merchant from Bögenhafen...
ransom.Fail: {name} gets no ransom for: {target}. The matter is getting loud.

toll.Name: Bridge Toll
toll.Desc: The band blocks a bridge or ford and takes a “toll” from everyone who wants to cross.
toll.Fail: {name} meets travellers who will not pay. Someone ran for the watch.

river_run.Name: River Run
river_run.Reward: the load's value times 2.5 and times the route (SL 3+: Scrutiny −1); needs cargo
river_run.Desc: A night run with contraband past the locks and customs posts. Takes the most valuable cargo from the stash; on a failure the load goes to the bottom.
river_run.Success: {name} brings the barge through and hands the load to the buyer.
river_run.Fail: {name} turns back before the post. The cargo had to be sunk.

cache.Name: The Stash
cache.Desc: Hiding cargo and traces in sunken crates, under floorboards or in the reeds.
cache.Success: {name} hides everything that should not be seen.
cache.Fail: {name} finds no safe place. The goods stay in plain sight.

contraband.Name: Contraband Pickup
contraband.Reward: contraband to carry (SL 3+: a second load)
contraband.Desc: A meeting with a supplier at a lonely landing. Goods on credit, paid after the sale.
contraband.Success: {name} returns with goods from the supplier.
contraband.Fail: {name} waits until dawn, but the supplier never comes. Someone may have followed them.

buy_secret.Name: Buy a Secret
buy_secret.Reward: a document to sell or report; on SL 3+ a Lead
buy_secret.Desc: A few coins for a maid, a scribe or a drunken sergeant in return for something they should not say.
buy_secret.Success: {name} returns with a secret written on a scrap of paper.
buy_secret.Fail: {name} runs into someone who starts asking questions.

letter_swap.Name: Swap a Letter
letter_swap.Reward: 2d10+5 SS times the target, +5 OXP (SL 3+: a document)
letter_swap.Desc: Intercept a letter, copy it and slip it back, or swap it for a forgery.
letter_swap.InputPlaceholder: e.g. the burgomaster's correspondence, orders for the garrison...
letter_swap.Success: {name} swaps the letter: {target}. Nobody noticed a thing.
letter_swap.Fail: {name} could not put the letter back in time: {target}. The recipient knows someone read it.

report.Name: Report to the Principal
report.Reward: the document's value times 1.25, no risk (SL 3+: another 1d10 SS); needs a document
report.Desc: The most valuable document in the safehouse goes to the principal, who pays better than a secret-buyer and tells no one.
report.Success: {name} hands the document to the principal and collects the payment.
report.Fail: {name} brings the document, but the principal finds it worthless. It goes back to the safehouse.

ritual.Name: Ritual
ritual.Desc: Night rites in a cellar or on a hilltop. The faithful return full of fervour.
ritual.Success: {name} leads the ritual. The faithful leave changed.
ritual.Fail: {name} stumbles over the invocation. The faithful whisper of an ill omen.

infiltrate.Name: Infiltration
infiltrate.Reward: Recon token; on SL 3+ a Lead
infiltrate.Desc: A cultist enters a guild, temple or rich house as a servant or guest.
infiltrate.Success: {name} wins trust and returns with the layout of the house and its people's habits.
infiltrate.Fail: {name} never gets past the threshold. Nobody there needs a new face.

abduction.Name: Abduction
abduction.Reward: 2d10+5 SS from the Master times the target, +1 Morale (SL 3+: +5 OXP and spoils)
abduction.Desc: Someone vanishes from the street at night. The Master pays and asks nothing, and the brotherhood does not say why.
abduction.InputPlaceholder: e.g. a beggar from the temple steps, a councillor's son...
abduction.Fail: {name} failed to take: {target}. The screams woke the whole street.

intercept.Name: Intercept a Courier
intercept.Desc: An ambush on a courier on the road. The satchel of letters changes hands before anyone notices.
intercept.Success: {name} returns with the courier's satchel full of letters.
intercept.Fail: {name} spooked the courier, who galloped straight to the nearest guardhouse.

stone_circle.Name: The Stone Circle
stone_circle.Desc: A night journey to an old ring of standing stones in the wilds. Sometimes those who came before left something behind.
stone_circle.Success: {name} returns from the circle before dawn. The faithful hang on every word of the tale.
stone_circle.Fail: {name} wanders the wilds and comes back soaked and empty-handed.

v-r1.Text: The shepherd from Altenhof swears he saw a horned figure in the woods carrying a sheep on its shoulders like a child.

v-r2.Text: The count's tax collector comes next week – and this time he brings six armed men.

v-r3.Text: The miller's daughter heals with a touch. The priest of Sigmar has already asked about her at the inn.

v-r4.Text: Grandfathers hid valuables before the war in the ruined tower beyond the marsh. No one who went looking came back.

v-r5.Text: A cloth merchant from Streissen is heading to the fair with a full wagon – and only two servants.

v-r6.Text: The reeve takes a cut from the smugglers for turning a blind eye to the path through the marshes.

v-r7.Text: The cattle died on the neighbouring farm. They say it's a curse, but the well water stinks of sulphur.

v-r8.Text: A witch hunter has stopped at the inn. He is asking about strangers who arrived this month.

f-r1.Text: Red Otto's band has made camp by the old oak. They pay for news of convoys.

f-r2.Text: Blood-marked stones have appeared by the road. The gamekeeper says not to go that way after dark.

f-r3.Text: A salt convoy leaves Kemperbad in three days. The escort are mercenaries owed back pay.

f-r4.Text: The count has set a bounty on poachers. Two already hang at the crossroads.

f-r5.Text: A wrecked mail coach lies in the ravine. No one took the strongbox, because everyone fears whatever wrecked it.

f-r6.Text: At night there are lights in the forest and the sound of drums. Woodcutters avoid the clearing by the spring.

f-r7.Text: The herbwife in the hut at the forest's edge buys any mandrake and asks no questions.

f-r8.Text: A roadwarden patrol is looking for an escaped prisoner. They pay silver for his hiding place.

m-r1.Text: A dwarf clan from Karak Hirn is looking for people to carry a load over the pass – no questions asked.

m-r2.Text: Campfire smoke was seen on the eastern slope. The herders talk of greenskins.

m-r3.Text: The abandoned shaft above the village still has a vein of silver. The owner died, and the heirs sit in Nuln.

m-r4.Text: A blizzard comes in two days. Whoever doesn't get off the pass will stay on it until spring.

m-r5.Text: The pass wardens take a toll from every wagon – and a second, unofficial one from those who don't want to be searched.

m-r6.Text: A Tilean caravan lies under last year's avalanche. In spring its wheels poke out of the snow.

m-r7.Text: Something big lives in the cave above the waterfall. Goats go missing, and the tracks are larger than a man's hand.

m-r8.Text: You can sell anything at the inn on the pass – as long as the dwarf behind the counter gets his cut.

v-e1.Title: The reeve's dogs
v-e1.Text: The farm dogs barked all night. Nobody slept.

v-e2.Title: Hospitable widow
v-e2.Text: The widow from the last cottage brought a pot of porridge in exchange for chopped firewood.

v-e3.Title: Harvest festival
v-e3.Text: The village is celebrating. The crew drinks for free and listens for who has the fullest barn.

v-e4.Title: Robbing the robbers
v-e4.Text: A sack of supplies is missing in the morning. Small bare footprints lead to the village.

v-e5.Title: Levy
v-e5.Text: The count's men are looking for peasants for the army. The crew hides in the woods until dawn.

v-e6.Title: Lost purse
v-e6.Text: A drunk merchant dropped his purse on the road to the inn.

v-e7.Title: Peasant brawl
v-e7.Text: The farmhands wanted to chase the strangers off. It ended with a few bruises and some respect.

v-e8.Title: Marsh fog
v-e8.Text: Thick fog and strange lights over the marsh. The sentries swear something was watching them.

f-e1.Title: Wolves
f-e1.Text: A pack circled the camp until dawn. The fire had to be fed all night.

f-e2.Title: Boar in a snare
f-e2.Text: In the morning a young boar thrashes in the snare. Meat for several days.

f-e3.Title: Songs by the fire
f-e3.Text: Someone took out a pipe. A ballad of Robert of Wissenland lifted everyone's spirits.

f-e4.Title: Beastmen signs
f-e4.Text: Someone carved signs in blood on the trees around the camp. Nobody heard the intruders.

f-e5.Title: Dead messenger
f-e5.Text: A dead messenger lies in the ditch by the road. A few coins are left in his bag.

f-e6.Title: Downpour
f-e6.Text: A downpour flooded the camp. Wet blankets, wet provisions and grim faces.

f-e7.Title: Forest brothers
f-e7.Text: Outlaws from a neighbouring band came to trade: meat for news from the town.

f-e8.Title: Mushrooms
f-e8.Text: The crew's forager found a clearing full of mushrooms. Luckily the cook recognised the poisonous ones.

m-e1.Title: Frost
m-e1.Text: The night was so cold that the water froze in the waterskins.

m-e2.Title: Avalanche
m-e2.Text: The roar of an avalanche woke the camp. The path down is buried – time to dig.

m-e3.Title: Dwarf trader
m-e3.Text: A dwarf with a mule stopped by the fire and sold hardtack at a fair price.

m-e4.Title: Eagle's cry
m-e4.Text: An eagle snatched a sack of dried meat from the camp.

m-e5.Title: View from the pass
m-e5.Text: At dawn the mist fell away and the whole Empire lay below. Even the worst cutthroats fell silent for a moment.

m-e6.Title: Orc tracks
m-e6.Text: Heavy boot prints and blood in the snow. Someone fought here recently.

m-e7.Title: Cave
m-e7.Text: A scout found a dry cave with firewood left by herders.

m-e8.Title: Lost ingots
m-e8.Text: A silver ingot gleams in a crevice by the path – someone dropped it at the crossing.

Rumors: In Middenheim they say miners in the deep shafts under the Fauschlag hear squeaking and claws scratching at the rock at night.
Graf Boris Todbringer appears in public less and less. In the palace corridors there is whispering about the ruler's growing apathy and black melancholy.
News from Altdorf of new war taxes imposed by the chancellor. The Middenland nobility speaks openly of treason.
Cultists of the Purple Hand and the Yellow Fang are making contact with bands of deserters and outlaws in the woods around Carroburg.
Barge traffic on the Reik has been halted; the toll collectors in Kemperbad demand a triple fee in war coin under threat of confiscation.
Suspicious cloaked men were seen in the merchants' alleys buying up old plans of dwarf tunnels and sewers.
A Road Warden unit near Altdorf deserted with full kit and firearms after their commander vanished with their pay.
At the Leaping Dog someone is offering high rewards in gold for information about mysterious deaths among physicians and scholars.
Celestial wizards in the capital warn of an unusual alignment of the stars – they foretell a bloody fratricidal conflict in Reikland.
Smugglers from the river Delb report that dwarf holds in the Middle Mountains are closing their gates to refugees from the lowlands.
Columns of Middenland soldiers with a full siege train were seen on the road from Middenheim to Altdorf – heading south.
Bounty hunters are looking for a scarred man who reportedly steals relics of Sigmar from wayside shrines.
Marienburg merchants talk of a new war tax – whoever doesn't pay has their ship and cargo confiscated.
Rumours speak of strange lights over the Drakwald. Foresters say it's witchfire, but scholars talk of a Warp storm.
Someone saw heralds in the Emperor's colours riding through villages, recruiting peasants with promises of 5 shillings a day and a hot meal.
TavernGossip: The innkeeper whispers that the local goldsmith is really a fence for the thieves' guild. He has a stash under his workshop floor.
A drunk soldier tells of a secret passage under the town walls that smugglers used back in the days of the great plague.
A Nuln merchant complains of a band of river pirates in green scarves – they only attack barges carrying firearms.
An old washerwoman says the burgomaster's daughter is secretly meeting an elf merchant from Marienburg. A scandal ready to explode.
Two guards discuss gaps in the watch rota – for a week nobody has guarded the west gate after midnight.
A bard sings a song about Karl Franz – but changes the words to mock him. Half the room laughs, the other half clenches their fists.
A serving girl says she saw someone in a hooded robe throwing something into the town well on the market square yesterday.
A horse dealer discreetly offers 'special services' – for the right price he'll smuggle people in a false-bottomed wagon.
A priest of Sigmar sits alone in a corner drinking. When someone speaks to him, he mutters about 'treason in the temple' and 'false prophets'.
A card player in the corner loses on purpose – it's a trick. He watches who has a full purse and signals a pickpocket by the door.
Arguing comes from the kitchen – the cook accuses the supplier of poisoned meat. 'That's not beef, you swine, those are rat paws!'
A traveller from Sylvania tells of the dead marching at night in the east. Nobody believes him, but he trembles with fear himself.
ShadowResults: The target discreetly visited a warehouse behind the harbour and met an unknown man in a leather jerkin. They exchanged bundles.
The target bought a large amount of dried provisions and rope at the market – as if preparing for a long journey into the wilds.
The target met a woman in a dark cloak under a bridge. They spoke in whispers and left in opposite directions.
The target entered a building marked with Sigmar's hammer, but left by the back door in different clothes.
The target sent a letter by courier. The courier rode west, toward the road to Marienburg.
The target had a long talk with a guard at the gate. They seemed to know each other well – the guard let him through quietly.
The target visited the Golden Maiden brothel, but not for pleasure – upstairs he met a man with a soldier's bearing.
The target spent two hours in the library of the temple of Verena reading old parchments. He copied something and hid the notes in his coat.
The target bought a vial of an unidentified liquid on the black market from an old herbwife. He paid twice what it was worth.
The target went to a dwarf's forge and ordered a duplicate key. The dwarf didn't like the business, but the money persuaded him.
IntimidationResults: The innkeeper shakes with fear and hands over the whole day's takings. He won't tell anyone – at least for now.
The merchant pays protection without blinking – clearly not the first time. He throws in information about his competitors as a gift.
The craftsman pays, but he is furious. He may complain to the watch if he finds the courage.
The peasant hands over his last pennies and begs for mercy. The crew feels uneasy (−1 Morale).
A town watchman agrees to look the other way in exchange for regular 'donations'. A useful contact for the future.
The trader pays, but warns: 'My brother is in the Road Wardens. Better we don't meet again.'
ForgeDocuments: A travel pass with Graf Todbringer's seal – allows free passage through Middenland.
A letter of recommendation from the 'Altdorf Merchants' Guild' – opens doors in trading circles.
A forged arrest warrant signed by a judge – useful for intimidating or abducting a target.
A forged officer's commission in the Reikland army – grants the right to requisition horses and supplies.
A forged customs seal – lets you avoid tolls at barriers and bridges.
A letter of safe conduct from the 'Knights Panther' – guarantees safety in their territories.
A nobleman's forged will – can be used to claim an inheritance or seize an estate.
An indulgence bearing the seal of the Temple of Sigmar – prized by the pious, worth a few crowns on the black market.
SmuggleComplications: The gate check is lax – the guard is dozing at his post. The goods pass smoothly.
The watch is more alert after a night alarm. Wait and try again at dawn.
A customs officer eyes the cargo suspiciously, but a 2-shilling bribe settles the matter.
A road patrol stops travellers and checks wagons. Luckily the false floor survives the inspection.
The run goes well, but a rival gang spots the route and may want to take it over.
The harbour watch uses tracking dogs – one of them nearly sniffed out the hidden goods.
The contraband arrives, but the buyer doesn't show at the agreed time. You have to wait somewhere risky.
Everything went smoothly. The buyer is pleased and adds a tip and news of the next job.

CampEvents.Title: A quiet night
CampEvents.Text: The sentries kept watch and the fire burned bright. Everyone rested undisturbed.

CampEvents.Title: Unsettling howls in the dark
CampEvents.Text: Sounds of wild beasts or beastmen came from the thicket. The sentries kept their weapons ready.

CampEvents.Title: Quarrel over the pot
CampEvents.Text: Two crew members fought over the last bowl of porridge. The chief had to step in.

CampEvents.Title: Found bundle
CampEvents.Text: A bundle of dried meat and hardtack was found abandoned in a ditch near the camp.

CampEvents.Title: Night thief
CampEvents.Text: Someone crept up on the camp under cover of fog. If the sentries were alert, he fled in fright.

CampEvents.Title: Pouring rain
CampEvents.Text: A downpour soaked everything and everyone. The makeshift shelters leak. The crew curses the weather.

CampEvents.Title: Stories by the fire
CampEvents.Text: Someone started telling a tale of old battles and heroes. Everyone listened with bated breath.

CampEvents.Title: Patrol nearby
CampEvents.Text: A watch detachment rode past the camp. Luckily they didn't notice the fire – or pretended not to.

CampEvents.Title: Wolf pack
CampEvents.Text: Wolves surrounded the camp at night. The sentries had to make noise and wave torches to drive them off.

CampEvents.Title: Lucky find
CampEvents.Text: A sentry found a purse with a few coins on the path – someone dropped it in a hurry.

RumorSources: A fishwife from the fish market
A drunk soldier from the garrison
An old beggar by the gate
A former convict from the dungeons
A card player from the tavern

rookie.Name: Greenhorn
rookie.Desc: A fresh outlaw without much experience on the road.

veteran.Name: Veteran
veteran.Desc: +20 to tests + 50% chance to escape a wound.

lieutenant.Name: Right Hand
lieutenant.Desc: +30 to tests, authority (+1 crew Morale), command orders (unique rank – one per crew; needs over 60–80 days of service).

armor.Name: Leather Armour
armor.Bonus: 50% chance to avoid a wound when caught or as a 'Meat Shield'.

weapon.Name: Good Weapon
weapon.Bonus: +10 to fighting, intimidation, diversion and sabotage.

disguise.Name: Cloak and Disguise
disguise.Bonus: +10 to shadowing, smuggling, eavesdropping and forgery.

medkit.Name: Surgeon's Bag
medkit.Bonus: Heals the wounded straight to 'Ready' when tending the wounded.

horse.Name: Mount / Horse
horse.Bonus: +1 extra ration from every supply job.

bodyguard.Name: Bruiser / Bodyguard
bodyguard.Desc: Brute strength and thick skin. Shields the chief in melee and bulls a way through.

shadow.Name: Shadow / Knifeman
shadow.Desc: An assassin from dark alleys. Moves silently, puts a knife in your back and shadows targets without a trace.

marksman.Name: Poacher / Marksman
marksman.Desc: Hunter and sharpshooter. Covers comrades from range, takes down sentries and hunts in the wilds.

provocateur.Name: Sharper / Provocateur
provocateur.Desc: Tavern trickster and juggler. Confuses the watch, stirs up riots and steals the initiative.

scavenger.Name: Scavenger / Barber-Surgeon
scavenger.Desc: Forager and patcher. Sets broken bones, brews salves and finds loot where others see rubbish.

smuggler.Name: Carter / Smuggler
smuggler.Desc: Master of roads and getaways. Knows forest shortcuts, can arrange a wagon and safely move hot goods.

saboteur.Name: Arsonist / Saboteur
saboteur.Desc: Pyrotechnician and wrecker. Starts fires, burns bridges behind a retreat and blows up supply wagons.

scout.Name: Scout / Tracker
scout.Desc: A woodland and highway tracker. Reads sign, spots pursuit and leads the crew along paths the watch never walks.

fixer.Name: Fence / Forger
fixer.Desc: The man for papers, seals and well-placed crowns. Forges safe-conducts, buys favours and moves whatever needs moving.

charlatan.Name: Charlatan / Hedge Healer
charlatan.Desc: A wandering quack, herbalist and seller of miracle ointments. Heals, patters and frightens the crowd with old superstitions.

duelist.Name: Swashbuckler / Duellist
duelist.Desc: A former duellist or hired blade. Has little honour but a fine sword; fights with flair and for show.

sergeant.Name: Sergeant
sergeant.Desc: Holds the line and keeps discipline. First in the shield wall, last at the stewpot.

halberdier.Name: Halberdier
halberdier.Desc: Stops charges and pulls riders from their saddles. The hard core of any unit.

crossbowman.Name: Crossbowman
crossbowman.Desc: An accurate shot at range and a sharp eye on patrol.

standard_bearer.Name: Standard Bearer
standard_bearer.Desc: Carries the company's colours. Where the banner flies, men do not run.

surgeon.Name: Barber-Surgeon
surgeon.Desc: Stitches wounds, sets bones and knows when to amputate.

quartermaster.Name: Quartermaster
quartermaster.Desc: Knows the price of every sack of flour and can squeeze more from the baggage train than it holds.

helmsman.Name: Helmsman
helmsman.Desc: Knows every shoal and eddy. Steers the barge at night without a lantern.

boatman.Name: Boatman
boatman.Desc: Strong arms and a short temper. Rows, hauls barrels and fights when needed.

lookout.Name: Lookout
lookout.Desc: Sits at the bow and sees the customs men before they see the barge.

forger.Name: Forger
forger.Desc: Bills of lading, seals, guild stamps. Every cargo gets clean papers.

purser.Name: Purser
purser.Desc: Counts the barrels, haggles the price and remembers who is owed what.

eavesdropper.Name: Eavesdropper
eavesdropper.Desc: Sits in a tavern corner with a mug and hears every word at three tables.

courier.Name: Courier
courier.Desc: Knows the shortcuts, bridges and gates. The letter arrives before anyone notices it left.

enforcer.Name: Enforcer
enforcer.Desc: When words are not enough, the enforcer comes. Quiet work, no witnesses.

acolyte.Name: Acolyte
acolyte.Desc: Carries the candles, guards the sanctum and learns secrets they do not yet understand.

zealot.Name: Zealot
zealot.Desc: Believes without reserve and throws themself at anyone who stands in the brotherhood's way.

spy.Name: Spy
spy.Desc: Has friends in the town hall and the temple. Nobody suspects who they really serve.

assassin.Name: Assassin
assassin.Desc: Dagger, poison, garrotte. Comes once and leaves no trace.

orator.Name: Orator
orator.Desc: Can convince the desperate that the brotherhood will give what the gods refused them.

alchemist.Name: Alchemist
alchemist.Desc: Incense, poisons and draughts for the rites. Knows the doses that heal and the ones that kill.

field_medic.Name: Field Medic
field_medic.Desc: +10 to tending the wounded; 50% chance of instant healing

horse_thief.Name: Horse Thief
horse_thief.Desc: +10 to smuggling and supply; master of wagon getaways

iron_will.Name: Unbending
iron_will.Desc: +10 to watch and diversion; resistant to pain

keen_senses.Name: Perceptive
keen_senses.Desc: +10 to tavern eavesdropping and scouting; senses spies

quick_escape.Name: Quick as a Weasel
quick_escape.Desc: +10 to theft, diversion and escaping the watch

arsonist.Name: Firebug
arsonist.Desc: +20 to sabotaging buildings, bridges and wagons

poacher.Name: Poacher
poacher.Desc: +10 to supply and scouting; brings an extra ration

drinking_buddy.Name: Drinking Companion
drinking_buddy.Desc: +10 to tavern and rumours; makes contacts easily

tight_lipped.Name: Tight-Lipped
tight_lipped.Desc: Never betrays the hideout under questioning by the watch

knife_master.Name: Knife Master
knife_master.Desc: +10 to quiet shadowing, theft and alley fighting

surefooted.Name: Surefooted
surefooted.Desc: +10 to scouting, mine raids and covering tracks

ox_strong.Name: Strong as an Ox
ox_strong.Desc: +10 to highway robbery, mine raids and intimidation

animal_friend.Name: Friend of Beasts
animal_friend.Desc: +10 to smuggling, farm thefts and scavenging

steady_nerves.Name: Steel Nerves
steady_nerves.Desc: +10 to diversion, bribery and covering tracks

lucky.Name: Lucky Devil
lucky.Desc: +10 to pickpocketing, smuggling and covering tracks

alcoholic.Name: Drunkard
alcoholic.Desc: −10 to scouting and watch; 20% chance of being unfit after camp
alcoholic.Camp: drinks himself senseless and is unfit for duty

kleptomaniac.Name: Kleptomaniac
kleptomaniac.Desc: −1 Morale after a job; 15% chance of stealing from the treasury

loudmouth.Name: Loudmouth
loudmouth.Desc: −10 to shadowing and smuggling (gives away the position)

wanted.Name: Wanted
wanted.Desc: +1 Heat when caught; risk of being recognised

gambler.Name: Gambler
gambler.Desc: After camp, 25% chance of losing 1d6 SS from the treasury
gambler.Camp: gambles away the crew's money at cards

traitor.Name: Traitor
traitor.Desc: 10% chance of leaking information on a spying job (+1 Heat)
traitor.Camp: information about the crew leaks out — +1 Heat

brawler.Name: Troublemaker
brawler.Desc: Starts brawls; 15% chance of a fight in camp (−1 Morale)
brawler.Camp: starts a fight in camp (−1 Morale)

superstitious.Name: Superstitious
superstitious.Desc: −10 to night shadowing and sabotage for fear of bad omens

repulsive.Name: Repulsive
repulsive.Desc: −10 to tavern, rumours and fencing (puts people off)

glutton.Name: Glutton
glutton.Desc: Eats a double ration at every night camp
glutton.Camp: eats an extra ration of supplies

one_eyed.Name: One-Eyed
one_eyed.Desc: −10 to scouting and watch due to a blind spot

in_debt.Name: Chronic Debtor
in_debt.Desc: 10% chance after camp that creditors sniff around the hideout (+1 Heat)
in_debt.Camp: creditors are hard on his heels — +1 Heat

clumsy.Name: Heavy-Handed
clumsy.Desc: −10 to scavenging and forgery; breaks tools and ruins loot

panicker.Name: Panicker
panicker.Desc: An extra −1 Morale when his job ends in getting caught

bloodthirsty.Name: Bloodthirsty
bloodthirsty.Desc: Every successful diversion or intimidation gives +1 Heat through needless cruelty

squeamish.Name: Squeamish
squeamish.Desc: −10 to intimidation and tending the wounded

bad_leg.Name: Bad Leg
bad_leg.Desc: −10 to pickpocketing, smuggling and mine raids

greedy.Name: Greedy
greedy.Desc: 10% chance each night to pocket some small coin from the stash

nightmares.Name: Nightmares
nightmares.Desc: 15% chance each night of being unfit for duty

craft_chirurgeon.Name: Former Trade: Physician / Barber
craft_chirurgeon.Desc: Before taking to the road he stitched wounds and set bones. During night camp he automatically heals 1 wounded follower without using supplies.

craft_blacksmith.Name: Former Trade: Smith / Armourer
craft_blacksmith.Desc: Work at bellows and anvil gives strength and a knowledge of weapons. Permanent +10 to jobs with weapons and a 50% discount on gear for the crew.

craft_innkeeper.Name: Former Trade: Innkeeper / Brewer
craft_innkeeper.Desc: Knows the secrets of brewing and loosening tongues. Raises crew Morale by +1 every night camp, and tavern eavesdropping brings an extra rumour.

craft_merchant.Name: Former Trade: Factor / Merchant
craft_merchant.Desc: Knows trade routes, tolls and how to reckon profit. Increases the profit from fencing, theft and scavenging by +2 SS for every successful job.

craft_woodsman.Name: Former Trade: Forester / Poacher
craft_woodsman.Desc: Excellent knowledge of the wilds. Provides a free +1 ration of game at every night camp in the forest, and covering tracks gets +20.

craft_scribe.Name: Former Trade: Clerk / Scribe
craft_scribe.Desc: Can read, write and forge official papers. +20 to forging documents and +10 to bribing the watch and officials.

blood_brotherhood.Name: Blood Oath with the Chief
blood_brotherhood.Desc: Swore a bloody rite of loyalty. Will never betray, never panics in camp and once per session may take a Critical Wound aimed at the chief.

infamous_moniker.Name: Bloody Moniker
infamous_moniker.Desc: Terrifying tales about him travel the roads. +20 to extortion, intimidating merchants and diversion.

battle_scarred.Name: Battle-Hardened (War Scars)
battle_scarred.Desc: Survived many wounds and skirmishes. Even when wounded he doesn't lower crew Morale and can stand night watch in camp without penalty.

guard_contacts.Name: Man in the Watch
guard_contacts.Desc: Has a debtor or relative among the town's watchmen. Halves the risk of a watch raid and gives warning of a raid.

shadow_tongue.Name: Thieves' Cant
shadow_tongue.Desc: Fluent in secret signs and gutter slang. +10 to intelligence work, shadowing targets and fencing.

cold_blooded.Name: Cold Blood (Nerves of Steel)
cold_blooded.Desc: A ruthless, composed professional. When a job fails, ignores the first complication or loss of crew Morale.

CampEvent.HookSet: This matter will make itself known again.

Effects.NoTarget: No target selected – apply the effect by hand (target a token with T before issuing the order).
Effects.GMFailed: The GM could not apply the effects – apply them by hand.
Effects.MustFace: goes for the duellist and ignores the rest of the crew until the end of the round
Effects.Lured: falls for the lure – the GM decides where they run
Effects.StandsDown: leaves the fight (the GM decides: walks away or switches sides)
Effects.EvilEye: has −10 to attacks until the end of the round

meatshield.Name: Meat Shield!
meatshield.Desc: A ruthless reflex – yanking a follower straight into the path of a deadly blow.
meatshield.Effect: The blow hits the follower instead of the chief. The follower is wounded (unless saved by armour or a veteran's rank).

trip.Name: Trip
trip.Desc: The bruiser throws himself at the enemy's legs or jams a staff between his shins.
trip.Effect: The opponent must pass an Agility test or immediately gains the Prone condition.

bullrush.Name: Bull Rush
bullrush.Desc: The bruiser charges headlong, ramming into the enemy line with a great shield or sheer bulk.
bullrush.Effect: The enemy is pushed back 2 metres and loses 1 Advantage, and the chief closes to melee at once without a test.

flank.Name: Flank
flank.Desc: The shadow slips round behind the enemy, drawing away his guard and shield.
flank.Effect: The target loses its guard – it cannot Dodge or Parry the chief's next attack!

volley.Name: Volley from Hiding
volley.Desc: Archers hidden in the dark loose a hail of bolts, stones and poisoned knives.
volley.Effect: The chosen target is shot at: a ranged hit with Damage 4 + the SL of the Leadership test. The target may defend with a Dodge test.

kidneystrike.Name: Kidney Strike
kidneystrike.Desc: A silent leap from the shadows and a precise dagger thrust under the ribs.
kidneystrike.Effect: The opponent immediately gains the Bleeding condition and loses 1 Advantage!

cover.Name: Harassing Fire
cover.Desc: A steady hail of crossbow bolts forcing the enemy to cower behind cover.
cover.Effect: The enemy suffers −10 to all tests until the end of their turn and loses 1 Advantage.

disarm.Name: Disarming Shot
disarm.Desc: A steady hand – a precise bolt strikes the hand, hilt or belt of the foe.
disarm.Effect: The opponent must immediately pass a Difficult (−10) Strength test or drop the weapon in hand!

distract.Name: Feint / Steal the Advantage
distract.Desc: The provocateur yells at the top of his lungs, throws stones and shouts insults about the enemy's mother.
distract.Effect: The chief gains +2 Advantage, and the provoked enemy loses 1 Advantage!

smoke.Name: Smoke Screen
smoke.Desc: Bags of pepper and soot are thrown, or an alchemical smoke candle is lit.
smoke.Effect: Smoke covers the battlefield until the end of the next round: enemies suffer −10 to Perception and Ranged tests. The party may leave melee without a test.

sand.Name: Sand in the Eyes
sand.Desc: A sudden handful of gravel, ground glass and ash thrown straight into the eyes.
sand.Effect: The opponent gains the Blinded condition. It can only be removed by passing an Endurance test at the end of the turn.

resupply.Name: Battlefield Resupply
resupply.Desc: The scavenger runs in under fire, handing over a new weapon, a bolt or an alchemical draught.
resupply.Effect: An immediate free reload, an item passed into a hand, or 1 Bleeding condition bandaged.

retreat.Name: Barricade and Retreat
retreat.Desc: A follower tips over a market stall, sets barrels alight in an alley or slams a portcullis shut.
retreat.Effect: The pursuit is blocked – the party may break off combat at once and leave the fight safely.

draught.Name: Bitter Battle Draught
draught.Desc: A swig of the barber-surgeon's foul, throat-burning spirit with a predator's claw in the bottle.
draught.Effect: The chief or a chosen ally removes 1 Fatigued condition or ignores it until the end of the next round.

rally.Name: Battle Cry
rally.Desc: The chief roars an order, spurring on his companions and striking fear into the enemy.
rally.Effect: Removes the Broken condition from the chosen ally. The chief gains Advantage equal to the SL of the test (minimum 1).

coordinate.Name: Coordinate the Line
coordinate.Desc: The right hand takes command of the line, pointing out gaps in the enemy's defence.
coordinate.Effect: The chief and up to three allies within 6 metres may make a free move of half their Movement; leaving melee requires no test.

retaliation.Name: Crew's Revenge
retaliation.Desc: A furious counterattack! A follower throws himself at the foe to avenge the wounded leader.
retaliation.Effect: If the chief or an ally takes damage, the right hand counterattacks at once OR the chief gains +2 Advantage in return.

Notify.NoAdvantage: The character doesn't have enough Advantage for this order.
Notify.AlreadyThisRound: The chief has already given an order this round (an order uses their Action).
Notify.NotInRetinue: The chosen member is not part of the active retinue.
Notify.NeedsMember: This order needs a suitable member of the active retinue.
Notify.WrongRole: The chosen member doesn't meet this order's requirements.
Notify.NoTest: Cannot make a WFRP4e Leadership test for this character.

MeatShield.Saved: {name} throws themself in front of the blow, but {reason} absorbs the impact! The follower avoids a wound and stays ready!
MeatShield.Wounded: {name} takes the blow and is badly wounded!
MeatShield.Nobody: None of your people is able to throw themself in front of the blow!

Dialog.NeedRoles: To give the order “{order}” you need in the retinue: {roles}!
Dialog.MeatShieldWarning: Warning: {name} will throw themself in front of the sword blow, risking grave wounds or death!
Dialog.TargetHint: Target an enemy (T key on a token) before giving the order – the condition will be applied automatically.
Dialog.ChooseMethod: Choose how to give the order:
Dialog.LeadershipHint: The chief makes a Leadership test. Success – the order works; failure – no effect. The order uses the chief's Action (one per round).
Dialog.AdvantageHint: Automatic success without a roll. Cost: {cost} (you currently have {current}).
Dialog.DirectHint: An announcement in the chat for the GM to decide (no test).

bodyblock.Name: Body Block
bodyblock.Desc: The bodyguard steps in front of the chief and takes the blows on shield and back.
bodyblock.Effect: Until the end of the round the first melee attack against the chief hits the bodyguard instead. The chief gains 1 Advantage (a moment to catch their breath).

grapple.Name: Neck Grab
grapple.Desc: The bruiser grabs the enemy round the waist or by the collar and won't let go.
grapple.Effect: The opponent must pass a Strength test or gains the Entangled condition.

circle.Name: Ring of Guards
circle.Desc: The crew closes a ring round the chief, backs together, faces to the enemy.
circle.Effect: The chief loses the Surprised condition (if any) and gains 1 Advantage. Nobody comes at them from behind.

parry.Name: Parry
parry.Desc: The duellist steps between the chief and the enemy and turns the blow aside with the blade.
parry.Effect: The first melee attack against the chief this round has −20 to hit. The chief gains 1 Advantage.

riposte.Name: Riposte
riposte.Desc: The swashbuckler baits an attack to answer it in the same breath with a quick thrust.
riposte.Effect: The chosen opponent loses 1 Advantage. If they attack the chief this round and miss, the chief may immediately strike back.

challenge.Name: Challenge to a Duel
challenge.Desc: The swashbuckler insults the enemy with a smile and calls them to an honourable fight.
challenge.Effect: The opponent must pass a Willpower test; on a failure they go for the duellist and ignore the rest of the crew until the end of the round.

pindown.Name: Pinning Fire
pindown.Desc: A string of shots just over the head forces the target to hug the ground.
pindown.Effect: The chosen target must pass a Willpower test or gains the Surprised condition (takes cover and won't move).

fireoil.Name: Barrel of Lamp Oil
fireoil.Desc: The arsonist rolls a small barrel of lamp oil at the enemy and flings a lit rag after it.
fireoil.Effect: The target must pass an Agility test or gains the Ablaze condition.

caltrops.Name: Caltrops
caltrops.Desc: A handful of iron spikes flung under the feet of the charging.
caltrops.Effect: The target must pass an Agility test or gains the Prone condition.

collapse.Name: Cut Beam
collapse.Desc: A prop pulled away on a rope; a weight of crates or a slab of roof falls on their heads.
collapse.Effect: The target must pass a Difficult Agility test or gains the Stunned condition.

wagonwall.Name: Wagon Across
wagonwall.Desc: The carter stops the wagon so that it shields the chief from fire.
wagonwall.Effect: The wagon gives cover: ranged attacks against the chief this round have −10. The chief gains 1 Advantage.

spooked.Name: Spooked Horses
spooked.Desc: A crack of the whip and the enemy's horses rear up.
spooked.Effect: The chosen mounted opponent, or one beside a wagon, loses 1 Advantage. If they ride a horse the GM may ask for a Ride test; failing it means the Prone condition.

getaway.Name: Hauled Aboard
getaway.Desc: The carter grabs the chief by the arm and yanks them out of the melee onto the wagon seat.
getaway.Effect: The chief loses the Prone condition and may move 4 metres away without provoking opportunity attacks.

spot.Name: Weak Spot
spot.Desc: The scout points out a gap in the armour, a hole in the line or a lame leg.
spot.Effect: The chief's first attack this round gets +10 to hit. The chief gains 1 Advantage.

lure.Name: Decoy
lure.Desc: The scout shows up at a window or on a ridge and vanishes, drawing the enemy's attention.
lure.Effect: The opponent must pass an Intelligence test; on a failure they lose 1 Advantage and fall for the lure.

snare.Name: Snares
snare.Desc: A taut cord with a noose across the path of pursuit.
snare.Effect: The target must pass an Agility test or gains the Entangled condition.

forgedorder.Name: Forged Order
forgedorder.Desc: The fence waves a sealed paper and bellows an order in the name of the local reeve.
forgedorder.Effect: The target must pass an Intelligence test or gains the Surprised condition (frozen, unsure whom to believe).

payoff.Name: Generous Gift
payoff.Desc: The fence presses a purse into a soldier's hand and whispers how many more there could be.
payoff.Effect: A human opponent must pass a Willpower test; on a failure they leave the fight (the GM decides whether they walk away or switch sides). The purse (1d10 SS) is lost.

salve.Name: Hedge Healer's Salve
salve.Desc: The healer slathers the wound with a foul but surprisingly effective ointment.
salve.Effect: The chief (or a chosen ally) loses the Bleeding condition.

fumes.Name: Noxious Fumes
fumes.Desc: The charlatan smashes a flask of fluid smelling of rotten eggs and a dead cat.
fumes.Effect: The target must pass a Toughness test or gains the Fatigued condition.

evileye.Name: Evil Eye
evileye.Desc: The healer mutters an old curse and points a finger.
evileye.Effect: A superstitious target must pass a Willpower test or loses 1 Advantage and has −10 to attacks until the end of the round.

regroup.Name: Regroup
regroup.Desc: The Right Hand claps, whistles and the crew falls back into line.
regroup.Effect: The chief loses the Surprised condition and gains 1 Advantage; retinue allies may move 2 metres for free.

Rumors.Name: Crew: Rumours and News
Rumors.Desc: Rumours the crew picks up (scouting, eavesdropping, questioning). Drawn rumours don't repeat until you reset the table.

Events.Name: Crew: Camp Events
Events.Desc: Events of the night camp or the Crew Week. Result flags (Morale, supplies, coins) change the crew's state.

Tables.Created: Crew: created {count} rumour and event tables in the Tables tab (folder “{folder}”).
Tables.EventsUpgraded: The events table (terrain: {terrain}) was replaced with a new version ({count} entries).

ProfileEvents.Name: Camp Events
ProfileEvents.Desc: Night events of this company type. Some nights draw from this table instead of the terrain events. The result flags (Morale, supplies, coins, role, terrains) change the company's state.

Result.Arrested: {name} falls into the hands of the watch – Arrested for {time}. Heat +1.
Result.Chase: A chase and shouting in the street – Heat +1.
Result.WoundedLoud: {name} is Wounded, and the whole district talks about the brawl – Heat +1.

Meta.TargetHint: Target for the simplified test (before crew modifiers)
Meta.SkillHint: Skill used when testing from the member's sheet
Meta.TimeHint: Time in the game world (normal target, current terrain). A member does one job per camp rest.

0.Name: Shadows / Ghosts
0.Desc: The watch and the bounty hunters have no idea you exist.

1.Name: Local Gossip
1.Desc: Faint whispers in the taverns. No direct suspicion.

2.Name: Drawing Attention
2.Desc: More patrols in the district. Bribes for the watch cost double.

3.Name: Wanted Posters
3.Desc: Descriptions of your followers on the notice boards. Risk of arrest in the street.

4.Name: Hunted
4.Desc: Professional bounty hunters and witch hunters are on the retinue's heels.

5.Name: Manhunt / State of Emergency
5.Desc: Open season! Gates blockaded, hideouts raided, patrols with dogs.

favorite.Name: Patron's Favourites
favorite.Desc: Full trust, protection and access to lucrative jobs.

trusted.Name: Trusted Hands
trusted.Desc: Proven in the field. Regular jobs and bonuses.

neutral.Name: Strictly Business
neutral.Desc: A purely business relationship. Coin for work, no sentiment.

strained.Name: Strained Relations
strained.Desc: The patron is watching you closely. Delays risk his anger.

hostile.Name: On Thin Ice
hostile.Desc: Facing punishment or elimination! You must prove your loyalty.

Cut.Name: The Man's cut (%)
Cut.Hint: What percentage of the gross profit from jobs goes to The Man's syndicate (default 25%).

Cycle.Name: Crew rhythm
Cycle.Hint: Daily: every job resolves at once and the crew camps every night. Weekly: players plan assignments and the GM resolves the whole week in one report (jobs, camp, raids, desertion) – loot and risk count once a week.

Queue.Name: GM queue in daily mode
Queue.Hint: When enabled, jobs sent by players don't resolve at once – they wait until the GM clicks “Resolve Assignments” (or runs the night camp). Jobs sent by the GM resolve immediately. Does not apply to the Crew Week.

SheetStyle.Name: Company sheet style
SheetStyle.Hint: The Company Ledger is the new look of an Old World war ledger. Classic is the previous sheet.

Recruit.AlreadyChosen: Someone has already been recruited from this offer: {name}!
Recruit.NoActor: Could not find the crew actor linked to this recruitment!
Recruit.NoCandidate: Could not find the chosen candidate's data!
Recruit.ChatText: {user} recruited the outlaw {name} ({role}) into the crew.
Recruit.Flavor: Recruitment: New Faces in the Crew

Mod.RichWithLead: Rich target – the Lead removes the penalty

Ops.NoCargo: {mission}: no suitable loot to take along.

Loot.ItemDescHot: Crew loot: {origin} – hot goods, someone is looking for it.
Loot.DiscardText: Throw away, give away or hide {name} (~{value} SS) for good? The loot will disappear from the crew's hideout.

Report.TimedFlavor: Jobs whose time ran out (or that the GM finished)

Scout.Success: The scout combed the area and came back with valuable news.
Scout.Fail: The scout had to stay hidden – came back with nothing solid.

Shadow.Fail: {name} tried to shadow {target}, but was spotted and had to back off.

Tavern.Success: {name} bought a few rounds at the inn ({cost} SS from the stash) and drew out some interesting information.
Tavern.Fail: {name} sat in the tavern all day but heard nothing of value.

Procure.HorseBonus: (including +1 ration thanks to the pack horse)
Procure.Success: Success! Brought back {supplies} rations{horse} and {coins} silver shillings.
Procure.Fail: Nothing of value could be found without raising the alarm.

Pickpocket.Success: {name} robbed a few marks – cash: {coins} SS.

Loot.HotHint: Hot goods are best kept a while before they go to the fence.

Burglary.Success: {name} gets in and leaves before dawn with the loot.
Burglary.SuccessAt: {name} gets into {place} and leaves before dawn with the loot.
Burglary.Fail: {name} couldn't manage the lock, or a dog scared them off – time to run.

FarmTheft.Success: {name} comes back at night with a full sack from a peasant's farmyard.
FarmTheft.Fail: The dogs started howling before {name} reached the barn.

Highway.Success: Wagon stopped, the escort threw down their weapons – {name} takes the most valuable goods.
Highway.Fail: The escort was tougher than it looked. {name} barely escaped with their life.

MineRaid.Success: {name} carries ore out of the shaft before the guard changes.
MineRaid.Fail: The mine guards heard footsteps in the gallery. {name} had to flee in the dark.

Poaching.Fail: The game was spooked, and the gamekeeper walked the woods until dusk. {name} comes back empty-handed.

Racket.Success: The {district} turf pays for “protection”. Every night in the city the stash gets {daily} SS (per week: {weekly}), until rivals come to claim it.
Racket.Fail: The {district} turf already has its “protectors”. {name} leaves with nothing.

Fence.NothingToSell: {fence}: no loot that can be sold here.
Fence.Fail: {fence} turns up their nose and won't take the risk.
Fence.Returned: The loot goes back to the hideout.

Intimidate.Success: {name} successfully intimidates the victim – takings: {coins} SS.
Intimidate.Fail: {name} tried to scare the target but met resistance. The crew grumbles (Morale −1).

RumorSpread.Success: {name} spread the rumour: “{rumor}”. By evening the whole area is talking about it.

Bribe.NotArrested: This crew member is not under arrest.
Bribe.Released: The jailer “lost” his keys – {name} walks out of the cells.
Bribe.HeatDown: The report on the crew ends up in the stove – Heat −1.
Bribe.Fail: {name} hands over a bribe ({cost} SS), but the official takes the money and does nothing.

TheMan.Note: A coded message was passed to the local cell of The Man's syndicate. The answer will come through secret channels.

Diversion.Success: {name} causes a commotion (a tavern brawl, a false alarm, tipped-over barrels). The watch is busy; the party can seize the moment.
Diversion.Fail: {name} tries to cause a distraction, but the watch quickly gets the commotion under control.

Sabotage.Success: {name} successfully sabotaged {target}. The damage will hamper the enemy.
Sabotage.Fail: {name} tried to sabotage {target}, but ran into problems – the target is intact.

Smuggle.Fail: {name} tried to smuggle {cargo}, but the goods were confiscated or had to be abandoned!

Forge.Success: {name} prepared the document: {doc}. The seal looks convincing and the ink is dry – ready to use.
Forge.Fail: {name} tried to forge {doc}, but the result is poor – any official with a little experience will spot the fake.

CoverTracks.Success: {name} covers the tracks and moves the camp. The chance of night trouble and raids is reduced.
CoverTracks.Fail: {name} failed to cover the tracks properly.

Tend.Medkit: {name} used a proper surgeon's bag and herbs to dress {wounded}'s wounds. Status: Wounded → Fully Ready! Can act right away!
Tend.Resting: {name} looks after the wounded {wounded} – changed the dressings and gave herbs. Status: Wounded → Resting. Ready for action tomorrow.
Tend.Nobody: {name} checked on the wounded, but everyone is already cared for or fully fit. A day spent sorting bandages and salves.

Shelter.NoFundsNotify: The stash is {cost} SS short for comfortable lodgings. Basic lodgings used instead.

Food.External: Meal from another source (inn, hospitality, hunting)
Food.Empty: No supplies! The crew went to bed hungry (−1 Morale)

Perk.Poacher: {name} (Poacher): caught a hare for supper (+1 ration).

rookie.Desc: A fresh mercenary without much experience on the road.

lieutenant.Desc: +30 to tests, authority (+1 company Morale), command orders (unique rank – one per company; needs over 60–80 days of service).

gambler.Camp: gambles away the company's money at cards

traitor.Desc: 10% chance of leaking information on a spying job (+1 Infamy)
traitor.Camp: information about the company leaks out — +1 Infamy

in_debt.Desc: 10% chance after camp that creditors sniff around the camp (+1 Infamy)
in_debt.Camp: creditors are hard on his heels — +1 Infamy

clumsy.Desc: −10 to scavenging and forgery; breaks tools and ruins spoils

bloodthirsty.Desc: Every successful escort, requisition or contract gives +1 Infamy through needless brutality

wanted.Desc: +1 Infamy after a failure; risk of being recognised

alcoholic.Desc: −10 to patrols and garrison duty; 20% chance of being unfit after camp

squeamish.Desc: −10 to requisitions, contracts and tending the wounded

craft_chirurgeon.Desc: Before taking to the road he stitched wounds and set bones. During night camp he automatically heals 1 wounded soldier without using supplies.

craft_blacksmith.Desc: Work at bellows and anvil gives strength and a knowledge of weapons. Permanent +10 to jobs with weapons and a 50% discount on gear for the company.

craft_innkeeper.Desc: Knows the secrets of brewing and loosening tongues. Raises company Morale by +1 every night camp, and tavern eavesdropping brings an extra rumour.

blood_brotherhood.Name: Blood Oath with the Captain
blood_brotherhood.Desc: Swore a bloody rite of loyalty. Will never betray, never panics in camp and once per session may take a Critical Wound aimed at the captain.

battle_scarred.Desc: Survived many wounds and skirmishes. Even when wounded he doesn't lower company Morale and can stand night watch in camp without penalty.

cold_blooded.Desc: A ruthless, composed professional. When a job fails, ignores the first complication or loss of company Morale.

craft_merchant.Desc: Knows trade routes, tolls and how to reckon profit. Adds +2 SS to the profit from each successful sale of trophies.

guard_contacts.Desc: Has a debtor or relative in the garrison. Halves the risk of an attack on the camp and gives warning of it.
guard_contacts.Name: Old Comrade in the Garrison

shadow_tongue.Name: Veterans' Cant
shadow_tongue.Desc: Knows the watchwords, signs and slang of the camps. +10 to patrols, garrison duty and selling trophies.

Effects.MustFace: goes for the duellist and ignores the rest of the company until the end of the round

meatshield.Effect: The blow hits the soldier instead of the captain. The soldier is wounded (unless saved by armour or a veteran's rank).
meatshield.Desc: The sergeant shoves a soldier in front of the captain, straight into the killing blow.

bullrush.Effect: The enemy is pushed back 2 metres and loses 1 Advantage, and the captain closes to melee at once without a test.
bullrush.Name: Polearm Shove

flank.Effect: The target loses its guard – it cannot Dodge or Parry the captain's next attack!

distract.Effect: The captain gains +2 Advantage, and the provoked enemy loses 1 Advantage!
distract.Name: To the Banner!
distract.Desc: The standard bearer raises the banner and the company answers with a roar that drowns out the enemy.

draught.Effect: The captain or a chosen ally removes 1 Fatigued condition or ignores it until the end of the next round.
draught.Name: Surgeon's Brandy
draught.Desc: A swig of strong spirit from the surgeon's flask puts you back on your feet.

rally.Desc: The captain roars an order, spurring on his companions and striking fear into the enemy.
rally.Effect: Removes the Broken condition from the chosen ally. The captain gains Advantage equal to the SL of the test (minimum 1).

coordinate.Effect: The captain and up to three allies within 6 metres may make a free move of half their Movement; leaving melee requires no test.

retaliation.Name: Company's Revenge
retaliation.Desc: A furious counterattack! A soldier throws himself at the foe to avenge the wounded leader.
retaliation.Effect: If the captain or an ally takes damage, the right hand counterattacks at once OR the captain gains +2 Advantage in return.

Notify.AlreadyThisRound: The captain has already given an order this round (an order uses their Action).

MeatShield.Saved: {name} throws themself in front of the blow, but {reason} absorbs the impact! The soldier avoids a wound and stays ready!

Dialog.LeadershipHint: The captain makes a Leadership test. Success – the order works; failure – no effect. The order uses the captain's Action (one per round).

bodyblock.Effect: Until the end of the round the first melee attack against the captain hits the bodyguard instead. The captain gains 1 Advantage (a moment to catch their breath).
bodyblock.Desc: The sergeant steps in front of the captain and takes the blow on the shield.

circle.Effect: The captain loses the Surprised condition (if any) and gains 1 Advantage. Nobody comes at them from behind.
circle.Name: Hedgehog!
circle.Desc: The company closes ranks around the captain and the banner, blades outward.

parry.Effect: The first melee attack against the captain this round has −20 to hit. The captain gains 1 Advantage.
parry.Name: Wall of Polearms
parry.Desc: The halberdier sets the polearm before the captain; nobody gets close without trouble.

riposte.Effect: The chosen opponent loses 1 Advantage. If they attack the captain this round and miss, the captain may immediately strike back.

wagonwall.Effect: The wagon gives cover: ranged attacks against the captain this round have −10. The captain gains 1 Advantage.
wagonwall.Desc: The quartermaster sets a baggage cart to shield the captain.

getaway.Effect: The captain loses the Prone condition and may move 4 metres away without provoking opportunity attacks.
getaway.Name: Drag Clear
getaway.Desc: The barber-surgeon grabs the captain by the arm and drags them out of the melee.

spot.Effect: The captain's first attack this round gets +10 to hit. The captain gains 1 Advantage.
spot.Desc: The crossbowman points out a gap in the armour seen down the sights.

forgedorder.Desc: The trader waves a sealed paper and bellows an order in the name of the local reeve.

salve.Effect: The captain (or a chosen ally) loses the Bleeding condition.
salve.Name: Surgeon's Stitches
salve.Desc: A few quick stitches and a tourniquet.

regroup.Desc: The Right Hand claps, whistles and the company falls back into line.
regroup.Effect: The captain loses the Surprised condition and gains 1 Advantage; retinue allies may move 2 metres for free.

challenge.Desc: The sergeant calls out the enemy's leader to fight before the line.
challenge.Effect: The opponent must pass a Willpower test; on a failure they go for the sergeant and ignore the rest of the company until the end of the round.

trip.Name: Halberd Hook
trip.Desc: The halberdier catches the enemy's leg or shield with the hook and pulls.

disarm.Name: Knock the Weapon Away
disarm.Desc: The halberd blade strikes the hilt and knocks the weapon from the hand.

volley.Name: Crossbow Volley
volley.Desc: On command the crossbowmen loose at the same moment.

evileye.Name: The Company's Colours
evileye.Desc: At the sight of the well-known colours the enemy remembers who they are facing.
evileye.Effect: The target must pass a Willpower test or lose 1 Advantage and suffer −10 to attacks until the end of the round.

lure.Name: Banner on the Hill
lure.Desc: The standard bearer shows the colours at the edge of the field and draws the enemy's eye the wrong way.

resupply.Name: Bandage and Bolts
resupply.Desc: The barber-surgeon runs up with a bandage, a bolt or a spare weapon.

fireoil.Name: Pot of Oil
fireoil.Desc: The quartermaster hurls a pot of burning oil from the cart.

payoff.Name: Pay for a Deserter
payoff.Desc: The quartermaster shows a purse and promises a place in the company.

retreat.Name: Fall Back to the Wagons
retreat.Desc: The company falls back behind the wagons, which block the pursuit.

bodyblock.Effect: Until the end of the round the first melee attack against the skipper hits the bodyguard instead. The skipper gains 1 Advantage (a moment to catch their breath).

circle.Desc: The crew closes a ring round the skipper, backs together, faces to the enemy.
circle.Effect: The skipper loses the Surprised condition (if any) and gains 1 Advantage. Nobody comes at them from behind.

parry.Desc: The duellist steps between the skipper and the enemy and turns the blow aside with the blade.
parry.Effect: The first melee attack against the skipper this round has −20 to hit. The skipper gains 1 Advantage.

riposte.Effect: The chosen opponent loses 1 Advantage. If they attack the skipper this round and miss, the skipper may immediately strike back.

getaway.Effect: The skipper loses the Prone condition and may move 4 metres away without provoking opportunity attacks.
getaway.Name: All Aboard!
getaway.Desc: The helmsman grabs the skipper by the arm and hauls them aboard.

spot.Effect: The skipper's first attack this round gets +10 to hit. The skipper gains 1 Advantage.
spot.Desc: The helmsman sees the enemy is standing on a slippery plank.

salve.Effect: The skipper (or a chosen ally) loses the Bleeding condition.

regroup.Effect: The skipper loses the Surprised condition and gains 1 Advantage; retinue allies may move 2 metres for free.

retaliation.Name: Cult's Revenge
retaliation.Desc: A furious counterattack! A cultist throws himself at the foe to avenge the wounded leader.
retaliation.Effect: If the high priest or an ally takes damage, the right hand counterattacks at once OR the high priest gains +2 Advantage in return.

Notify.AlreadyThisRound: The high priest has already given an order this round (an order uses their Action).

MeatShield.Saved: {name} throws themself in front of the blow, but {reason} absorbs the impact! The cultist avoids a wound and stays ready!

Dialog.LeadershipHint: The high priest makes a Leadership test. Success – the order works; failure – no effect. The order uses the high priest's Action (one per round).

bodyblock.Desc: The bodyguard steps in front of the high priest and takes the blows on shield and back.
bodyblock.Effect: Until the end of the round the first melee attack against the high priest hits the bodyguard instead. The high priest gains 1 Advantage (a moment to catch their breath).

circle.Desc: The cult closes a ring round the high priest, backs together, faces to the enemy.
circle.Effect: The high priest loses the Surprised condition (if any) and gains 1 Advantage. Nobody comes at them from behind.

parry.Desc: The duellist steps between the high priest and the enemy and turns the blow aside with the blade.
parry.Effect: The first melee attack against the high priest this round has −20 to hit. The high priest gains 1 Advantage.

riposte.Effect: The chosen opponent loses 1 Advantage. If they attack the high priest this round and miss, the high priest may immediately strike back.

wagonwall.Desc: The carter stops the wagon so that it shields the high priest from fire.
wagonwall.Effect: The wagon gives cover: ranged attacks against the high priest this round have −10. The high priest gains 1 Advantage.

getaway.Desc: The carter grabs the high priest by the arm and yanks them out of the melee onto the wagon seat.
getaway.Effect: The high priest loses the Prone condition and may move 4 metres away without provoking opportunity attacks.

spot.Effect: The high priest's first attack this round gets +10 to hit. The high priest gains 1 Advantage.
spot.Desc: The spy points out a gap in the armour.

salve.Effect: The high priest (or a chosen ally) loses the Bleeding condition.
salve.Name: Black Balm
salve.Desc: The wound is smeared with the brotherhood's thick black balm.

regroup.Desc: The Right Hand claps, whistles and the cult falls back into line.
regroup.Effect: The high priest loses the Surprised condition and gains 1 Advantage; retinue allies may move 2 metres for free.

grapple.Desc: The zealot seizes the enemy and holds on, even while being cut.

challenge.Name: Blasphemy
challenge.Desc: The zealot insults the enemy's god so badly that they forget everything else.
challenge.Effect: The opponent must pass a Willpower test; on a failure they go for the zealot and ignore the rest of the cult until the end of the round.

resupply.Name: The Ritual Dagger
resupply.Desc: The acolyte hands over a dagger, incense or a bandage before anyone asks.

retreat.Name: The Secret Passage
retreat.Desc: The acolyte opens a hidden door and the cult vanishes into the cellars.

lure.Desc: The spy shows themself at the end of the street and vanishes round the corner.

kidneystrike.Name: Poisoned Blade
kidneystrike.Desc: A poisoned blade grazes the enemy under the ribs.

sand.Name: Powder in the Eyes
sand.Desc: The assassin blows a blinding powder into the enemy's face.

smoke.Name: Censer Smoke
smoke.Desc: Thick smoke from a censer covers the field.

evileye.Name: The Master's Curse
evileye.Desc: The orator points at the enemy and speaks the Master's name.

payoff.Name: The Master's Promise
payoff.Desc: The orator promises the enemy what they want most.

forgedorder.Name: In the Temple's Name
forgedorder.Desc: The orator poses as a priest and gives orders in the temple's name.

fireoil.Name: Alchemical Fire
fireoil.Desc: The alchemist smashes a flask whose contents burst into flame on contact with air.

fumes.Desc: The alchemist breaks a flask of choking vapour.

GM.MissionTempoHint: 100 = default durations, 50 = twice as fast, 200 = twice as slow. 0 = every job ends at once.
GM.EffectiveHint: Duration now: normal target, current terrain, with tempo.
